idea-plugin.name: RoomEr - Room ER Diagrams
idea-plugin.description:
See your Room database as an entity-relationship diagram, right inside Android Studio.

RoomEr reads the schema JSON that Room exports at build time and draws it in the Room ER tool window: every table, column and key, with foreign keys drawn as crow's-foot relationships.

Features

  • Tables, columns and types with primary key, foreign key, unique, index and not-null markers
  • Foreign keys in crow's-foot notation, with inferred one-to-one / one-to-many cardinality
  • Views and FTS3/FTS4/FTS5 tables in their own styles, with a legend
  • Automatic layout; drag tables around and the positions are remembered per database
  • Search tables and columns, focus mode (a table and its neighbours), collapsible column lists
  • Go to source: jump from a table to its @Entity class (Kotlin or Java)
  • Export the diagram as a Mermaid erDiagram (copy, or save as .mmd)
  • Several databases per project; reloads automatically after a rebuild
  • Follows the IDE theme: light, dark and high contrast
  • Read-only and offline: no network access, no telemetry

Getting started

  1. Turn on schema export: keep exportSchema = true on your @Database and set room { schemaDirectory("$projectDir/schemas") } (Room Gradle plugin) or the room.schemaLocation KSP/kapt argument.
  2. Build the project, so Room writes schemas/<DatabaseClass>/<version>.json.
  3. Open View | Tool Windows | Room ER.

Schema files in another place? Use Choose schema folder… in the tool window.
